rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
$v_{rms} = \sqrt{\frac{3RT}{M}} = \sqrt{\frac{3kT}{m}}$, and $v_{avg} = \sqrt{\frac{8RT}{\pi M}}$, $v_{mp} = \sqrt{\frac{2RT}{M}}$.
Ratio of the three speeds: $v_{mp} : v_{avg} : v_{rms} = \sqrt{2} : \sqrt{8/\pi} : \sqrt{3} \approx 1.41 : 1.60 : 1.73$.
